topic: Building an LLM agent harness like DeepSeek Harness
goal: Understand every part of an agent harness modelled on DeepSeek Harness (dsh) and build a working one end to end: model calls, tool calling, the agent loop, an event-sourced session log, provider adapters, a plugin system, safe tools with approvals and a sandbox, context management, subagents, and a terminal and web front end.
pace: one to two months; owner asked for end to end from absolute basics
